gizmo.title: Mmalite ngwaọrụ mpụga
gizmo.description: Ngọngọ na-emepe ngwaọrụ mmụta mpụga na windo ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ na peeji, dịka njikọ nkịtị ma ọ bụ site na arịrịọ nbanye LTI 1.3.

configure.title: Aha
configure.description: Aha ngwaọrụ ahụ. E gosiri ya n'isi na na bọtịnụ.

configure.title: Nkọwa
configure.description: Ihe ndị mmụta na-eme na ngwaọrụ ahụ, e gosiri n'elu bọtịnụ.

configure.title: URL mmalite
configure.description: Adreesị ngwaọrụ ahụ. Ọ ga-abụrịrị adreesị zuru ezu na-amalite na https:// ma ọ bụ http://.

configure.title: Mepee na
configure.description: Windo ọhụrụ na-arụ ọrụ na ngwaọrụ ọ bụla. Na peeji a na-arụ ọrụ naanị na ngwaọrụ na-ekwe ka e gosi ha n'ime saịtị ọzọ.

advanced.title: URL nbanye LTI
advanced.description: Naanị LTI 1.3: adreesị mmalite nbanye nke ngwaọrụ ahụ. Site na nke a, client ID na deployment ID, bọtịnụ ahụ na-eziga arịrịọ nbanye LTI kama imeghe njikọ nkịtị. Imecha mmalite ahụ chọrọ ọrụ LTI nke saịtị a.

advanced.title: LTI client ID
advanced.description: Client ID ngwaọrụ ahụ nyere saịtị a. Njirimara ọha, ọ bụghị ihe nzuzo: etinyela igodo ma ọ bụ ihe nzuzo ebe a ma ọlị.

advanced.title: LTI deployment ID
advanced.description: Deployment ID ngwaọrụ ahụ nyere saịtị a. Njirimara ọha, ọ bụghị ihe nzuzo.

advanced.title: Onye nnyefe LTI
advanced.description: Adreesị na-egosi ngwaọrụ ahụ saịtị a. Hapụ ya efu iji jiri adreesị saịtị peeji ahụ dị na ya.

advanced.title: Ogo na peeji
advanced.description: Ogo ngwaọrụ ahụ mgbe ọ meghere na peeji a, na pikselụ (200 ruo 2000).

advanced.title: Agba ntụpọ
advanced.description: Agba akara isi na bọtịnụ. Hapụ ya efu ka o soro isiokwu.

developer.title: Ntụaka nbanye LTI
developer.description: Uru na-adịghị ahụ anya ọrụ LTI nke saịtị a na-eji amata onye mmụta. Saịtị na-enyekarị ya site na ihe omume lti-launch-request kama ichekwa ya ebe a. Ọ dịghị mgbe ọ bụ okwuntughe ma ọ bụ igodo.

developer.title: Ntụaka ozi LTI
developer.description: Uru na-adịghị ahụ anya ọrụ LTI nke saịtị a na-eji amata mmalite a. Saịtị na-enyekarị ya kama ichekwa ya ebe a.
